text: The flight control system shall command control surfaces within 20 ms of receiving a pilot input.
author: ryan

text: The flight control system shall detect a single sensor failure and continue operating without loss of function.
author: ryan

text: The system shall log all fault events with a timestamp resolution of 1 ms.
author: alex

text: The system shall provide a maintenance interface for downloading fault logs.
author: alex

text: The control law task shall execute at a fixed rate of 100 Hz.
author: alex

text: The software shall output surface commands to the actuator bus within 5 ms of completing the control law computation.
author: alex

text: The software shall compare redundant sensor channels and flag a channel as failed when they disagree by more than the configured threshold.
author: alex

text: The software shall exclude a failed sensor channel from the control law inputs.
author: alex

text: The software shall record each fault event in non-volatile memory with a 1 ms timestamp.
author: alex

text: The software shall display the current build identifier on the maintenance interface.
author: ryan
